Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 27183 of 2023
Applicant :- Servendra Kumar @ Ravindra Kumar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Jitendra Kumar,Keshav Hari Dixit,Purushottam Dixit
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Bharat Singh,G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Rejoinder affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Mohit Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Bharat Singh, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Suresh Bahadur Singh, learned AGA for the State.

3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 36 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Qadarchouk, District Badaun during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and four others and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was solemnized with sister of the informant in the year 2021 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for Buffalo, Rs. 50,000/- and motorcycle and on 22.01.2023 they hanged her.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation, applicant has been made accused in the present matter and applicant is however husband of the deceased but he neither demanded any dowry nor tortured the deceased in any manner.
6. He further submits that actually when even after more than one and half years of her marriage deceased could not conceive then only due to this reason under depression she hanged herself.
7. He further submits that post mortem report also suggests that she died due to hanging.
He further submits that it is a case of suicide and after incident on the basis of false allegation, applicant and his family members has been made accused in the present matter.

8. He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 30.01.2023 i.e. for last almost one and half years.
9. He further submits that even till date charges could not be framed, therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, applicant should be enlarged on bail.
10. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within seven years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand dowry, therefore, considering the provisions of Section 113B of Indian Evidence Act,
applicant should not be released on bail.

They further submits that till date charges could not be framed due to delaying tactics played by the parents of the applicant and this fact is evident from the order-sheet of the case.
11.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
12. Applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.

13. Further, applicant however has taken a specific defence that as even after one and half years of marriage deceased could not conceive, therefore, she committed suicide but defene taken by the applicant does not appear to be convincing.

14. Further, however, in the present matter applicant is in jail since January, 2023 i.e. for last almost one and half years and it appears to be a case of suicide but from the order-sheet it reflects that due to non cooperation of the parents of the applicant, who are on bail, till date not even charges could be framed.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is not entitled to be released on bail at this stage.
16. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is rejected at this stage.

18. However, considering the fact that applicant is in jail for almost one and half years, trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the case within a period of eight months from the date of production of certified copy of this order strictly as per provision of Section 309 Cr.P.C. on day-to-day basis without granting any unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no legal impediment.
